name: Rowing Machine

instructions.description: Sit on the rower with feet secured and grasp the handle.
Drive through the legs, then open the hips and draw the handle toward the lower ribs.
Extend the arms, hinge forward, and bend the knees to return.
Repeat with a smooth rhythm rather than pulling abruptly.

performanceMetrics.notes: Record the time performed with comfortable, controlled technique.
Record average movement or step cadence.
Record the individual's perceived effort after the exercise.

variations.variationDescription: Rowing Machine — Tempo-Controlled Version: Use a deliberately slower lowering phase without creating a separate database record.
Rowing Machine — Reduced-Range Version: Use a smaller comfortable range while preserving the same movement pattern.

commentsNotes: Prioritize a smooth leg-drive and controlled return.
